about.title: Dentistry treated as a craft, not a checklist
body: Signature Dental was started with a simple idea — that a neighborhood dental clinic doesn't have to feel clinical or rushed. Every patient here gets an unhurried consultation, a clearly explained treatment plan, and care that considers how your smile looks, not just how your teeth function.

We built our practice around cosmetic and restorative dentistry, from smile makeovers and veneers to implants and full-mouth rehabilitation, using modern equipment and sterilization protocols in a calm, private setting in Porur.

services.name: Smile Makeover & Veneers
services.tagline: A smile redesigned around your face, not a template
services.overview: Our signature service combines porcelain veneers, cosmetic bonding, and alignment corrections into a single, personalized smile design plan — built around digital mock-ups so you know what to expect before any work begins.
symptoms: Gaps or minor misalignment affecting confidence
Wanting a more polished smile for events or photos
procedure: Smile design consultation and digital mock-up
Shade matching and veneer or bonding plan
services.recovery: Most smile makeovers involve no downtime; mild sensitivity after veneer placement typically settles within a few days.

faqs.question: How long does a smile makeover take?
faqs.answer: Depending on scope, a full smile makeover typically takes 2–4 visits over 1–3 weeks, from design consultation to final fitting.

faqs.question: Are veneers permanent?
faqs.answer: Porcelain veneers are long-lasting — typically 10–15 years with good care — but they do involve minor, irreversible tooth preparation.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.overview: In-clinic whitening treatment that lifts years of staining in a single session, using professional-grade gels under controlled supervision rather than over-the-counter kits.
symptoms: Yellowing or staining from coffee, tea, or tobacco
Dullness after years of home whitening kits
benefits: Visible results in a single visit
services.recovery: No downtime; mild, temporary sensitivity is common for 24–48 hours after treatment.

faqs.question: How long do whitening results last?
faqs.answer: With good oral hygiene and limited staining foods, results typically last 6–12 months before a touch-up is needed.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.tagline: A permanent, natural-feeling replacement for missing teeth
services.overview: Titanium implants topped with custom-matched crowns, giving patients a stable, natural-feeling replacement for one or several missing teeth.
benefits: Functions and feels like a natural tooth
services.recovery: Initial healing takes about a week; full integration before the final crown is fitted typically takes 8–12 weeks.

faqs.question: Is the implant procedure painful?
faqs.answer: The procedure is done under local anesthesia and is generally well-tolerated; mild discomfort afterward is managed with standard pain relief.

services.name: Root Canal Treatment
services.overview: Modern, largely painless root canal treatment that removes infection while preserving your natural tooth structure wherever possible.
symptoms: Persistent tooth pain, especially with hot or cold
Swelling or tenderness near a tooth
procedure: Cleaning and shaping of root canals
services.recovery: Mild soreness for a few days is normal; most patients resume normal eating and routine the same day.

faqs.question: Does a root canal hurt?
faqs.answer: With modern anesthesia techniques, the procedure itself is largely painless — most patients report less discomfort than expected.

services.name: Full Mouth Rehabilitation
services.tagline: Comprehensive restoration for function and appearance
services.overview: A coordinated treatment plan combining implants, crowns, veneers, and gum care to fully restore patients with extensive dental wear, damage, or missing teeth.
symptoms: Significant wear from grinding or age
procedure: Staged treatment plan across required procedures
Restorative and cosmetic work in sequence
benefits: One coordinated plan instead of piecemeal treatment
services.recovery: Recovery is staged across the treatment plan and reviewed in detail during your consultation.

faqs.question: How long does full mouth rehabilitation take?
faqs.answer: Depending on complexity, treatment is typically staged over 2–6 months to allow proper healing between stages.

services.name: Routine Checkups & Cleaning
services.tagline: The foundation every great smile is built on
services.overview: Thorough dental checkups and professional cleaning to catch issues early and keep your smile in premium condition between larger treatments.
symptoms: Due for a routine six-month checkup
Plaque buildup or mild gum sensitivity
procedure: Clinical examination and digital X-ray if needed
benefits: Prevents costlier treatment down the line
Keeps your smile makeover results looking their best

faqs.question: How often should I get a checkup?
faqs.answer: We recommend a checkup and cleaning every six months for most patients.

blogPosts.title: What Actually Goes Into a Smile Makeover
blogPosts.excerpt: Smile makeovers get treated as one procedure, but they're usually a combination of several — here's how a plan actually comes together.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Ishaan Mehta
content: "Smile makeover" isn't a single procedure — it's a treatment plan that usually combines two or three techniques, chosen based on what your teeth actually need rather than a fixed package.

For some patients, that means whitening plus a small amount of cosmetic bonding to fix chips or gaps. For others with more wear or discoloration, porcelain veneers give a more controlled, longer-lasting result.
The process should always start with a digital mock-up or shade and shape discussion, so you have a clear idea of the outcome before any tooth structure is touched.

Timeline matters too — a conservative makeover with whitening and bonding can be done in a visit or two, while a veneer-based plan typically spans several appointments to allow for precise shade matching and fit.

The best outcomes come from a plan that looks proportionate to your face and existing teeth, not the most dramatic version possible — that's the difference between a smile that looks 'done' and one that just looks like yours, improved.
